extensionDescription.message: Fill forms with your saved profiles. Local, private, and always on your say-so.

fillCommand.message: Fill the current form with Fieldhand

popupIntro.message: Fill the form in front of you with a saved profile. You stay in control.

emptyProfile.message: This profile is empty. Add your details in Manage profiles.

confirmHttp.message: This page uses HTTP. I understand my details may travel over an unencrypted connection.

framesSkipped.message: Some embedded forms could not be accessed. Fill them manually.

staysLocal.message: Your data stays on this device.

unsupportedPage.message: Open a regular website to fill a form. Browser and store pages are protected.

insecurePage.message: Confirm the HTTP warning before filling this page.

operationFailed.message: Could not complete this action. Check page access, reload, and try again.

invalidSchema.message: Invalid profile data. Check names, dates, domains, and limits (100 profiles / 100 rules).

fileTooLarge.message: Choose a JSON file smaller than 2 MB.

yourDetailsYourDevice.message: Your details. Your device. Your choice.

optionsHeading.message: A little setup. A lot less typing.

optionsIntro.message: Keep a profile for every part of your life. Choose one whenever you need it.

privacyNote.message: Profiles are stored locally and are not encrypted. Never save passwords, payment details, or other secrets. Filling shares your chosen details with the website, which may send them to its servers.

domainsHint.message: Optional domains, separated by commas. Example: linkedin.com

customRulesHint.message: Your rules take priority. Sensitive fields are always excluded.

preferencesHint.message: These preferences apply to all profiles.

overwrite.message: Replace values already entered in forms

diagnostic.message: Show diagnostic reasons in the console (never values)

shortcutSettings.message: Shortcut: Alt + Shift + F. Change it in your browser's extension keyboard shortcut settings.

backupIntro.message: Export your saved profiles or bring them to another device yourself.

exportWarning.message: JSON backups are not encrypted and contain your personal details. Store them somewhere safe.

importPreviewHint.message: The file is valid. Review the profiles before saving.

replaceWarning.message: Merge adds copies with new IDs and keeps your preferences. Replace removes all existing profiles and uses the imported preferences.

confirmDelete.message: Delete profile “$1”? This cannot be undone.
